What's been going on?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I had a meeting with my supervisor today and it didn't go as I'd hoped."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. What happened in the meeting?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Well, I tried to bring up how I've been feeling undervalued and how it's affecting my motivation at work."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really tough. Were they at least receptive to what you said?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Not really... They seemed to dismiss my concerns again, just like last time."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm really sorry to hear that, Amanda. It must be so frustrating to feel unheard."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It is. I've been trying so hard to improve things since the negative review, but it feels like nothing I do is ever enough."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"You're putting in so much effort, and it's unfortunate that it's not being recognized. How are you holding up emotionally?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, it feels draining. Sometimes I wonder if I'm just not good enough for this job."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's such a difficult place to be in. But remember, your worth isn't determined by someone else's recognition or lack thereof."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thank you for saying that. It helps a little to hear. I just wish things were different at work."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's completely okay to want things to change. Would it help to focus on small steps towards feeling valued elsewhere, maybe with your coworkers?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Actually, I made amends with a coworker a few months back and our collaboration has improved a lot."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's great to hear! Having supportive colleagues can make a huge difference. Maybe that's a positive thing to build on?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, it feels nice to have at least one person be supportive. But it's still hard with my supervisor actively undermining my efforts."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I can imagine how exhausting that is. Have you thought about what steps you might want to take next regarding your job situation?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I have thought about looking for a new job, but I'm not sure if I have the energy to go through that process right now."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Looking for a new job is a big step and it can be intimidating. Maybe focus on building your confidence first and taking it one day at a time?"}]
